column1: # Hand-authored Hanja reading rules over the generated hanja_readings.tsv (2026-10-04).
# Loaded with hanja=korean only. See docs/cjk-korean-reading.ko.md.
# 한글 맞춤법 제11항 붙임 1: after a vowel or ㄴ, 렬 and 률 are written 열 and 율
# (比率 비율, 旋律 선율, 分裂 분열); after other final consonants they stay (法律 법률).
# 不 reads 부 before a syllable beginning with ㄷ or ㅈ (不正 부정, 不動産 부동산, 不得已 부득이).
# A character whose own reading differs from the form it stands for in Chinese or Japanese
# (2026-10-26). Chinese: a sentence with neither Hangul nor kana under matrix=declared
# (银行几点 은행기점, 台湾 대만, 广告 광고); Japanese: a sentence with kana (予約 예약, 体 체).
